scope: Whole-App native playback archive load from an idle/no-device source, using the existing session/device worker and common restore transaction
changes: Reader thread validates the nested original PCM output archive before acquiring source fences or opening a native device; Fencing uses constant-time rate metadata lookup
Cancellable owned Device load stage has 20-second observation timeout and polls original native worker initialization/pause
Host native policy or an existing native window is required; an archive cannot independently authorize output
Original idle checkpoint remains logically null while its provisional empty device is prepared and queue is frozen
Provisional output mode is guarded; sample rate must match exactly and no resampling is performed
Original CPU/GPU/UI/native readiness and final receipt publish saved PCM/pump/scene/Play and adopt the prepared device only at commit
Cancellation/error asynchronously closes only provisional output through original session ownership; no frame-thread device join
Active native, native-to-idle and ordinary offline paths remain in the same owners/codecs

checks.diff: scoped git diff --check passed; touched sources are preexisting untracked files

regressions: Complete source-free active→idle→native file/CPU/GPU/UI/device/PCM cycle followed by 120 game/render frames
Cancellation during device initialization and after native readiness preserves original idle scene and playback state; worker retirement polled normally
Valid outer editor file with damaged nested output rejects on reader before any source barrier or device
Failure after provisional device reached paused/ready state restores original idle source and retires the new device
Actual native Session sample-rate mismatch and output-policy change reject and clean up without changing source playback
Idle source JSON remains exact while prepared device is held
Committed PCM queue and pump suffix match original archived bits exactly before final gate release; final receipt retains the adopted native device
CPU test verifies source checkpoint and host authorization requirements without opening any device
Existing model/UI pixel comparisons, counters, full active-native/Stop/idle workflows and late-source guards pass
limitations: Provisional device may emit empty zero-filled callbacks before pause; gain-zero tests do not prove audible continuity or analog host-buffer alignment
After cancel/timeout, native initialization/destruction remains owned and asynchronous; further restore admission may wait for normal worker retirement
Offline playback archives without native queues still require an explicit cross-mode conversion path; active offline source to native is not qualified
Different sample rates/capacities are rejected without lossy conversion; reconnect and device replacement remain open
Native window, frame-time/120/160 FPS, latency, power and full ENG-03 through ENG-13 remain open
